Impacted Systems: Warner Music Group's US online stores
Attack Vector: Compromised online stores, installed data skimmers

Method of Attack: Sending premium rate SMS messages, conducting purchases through WAT billing
Attack Vector: Malicious functionalities added to initially clean applications
Indicators of Compromise: Six apps detected and removed from Google Store, downloaded 200,000 times

Method of Attack: Spear phishing emails, deployment of RAT
Discoverer: Researchers reporting on Chinese APT TA413
